# manager.trainer.get_last_model { #spotforecast2_safe.manager.trainer.get_last_model }

```python
manager.trainer.get_last_model(model_name, model_dir=None)
```

Get the latest trained model from the cache.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name       | Type                                                                                             | Description                                                                       | Default    |
|------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| model_name | [str](`str`)                                                                                     | Name of the model (e.g., 'lgbm', 'xgb').                                          | _required_ |
| model_dir  | [Optional](`typing.Optional`)\[[Union](`typing.Union`)\[[str](`str`), [Path](`pathlib.Path`)\]\] | Directory where models are stored. If None, defaults to the library's cache home. | `None`     |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                                                  | Description                                                       |
|--------|-------------------------------------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | [int](`int`)                                          | A tuple (iteration, model_instance). If no model is found on disk |
|        | [Any](`typing.Any`)                                   | (cache directory missing, no matching files, or no parseable      |
|        | [tuple](`tuple`)\[[int](`int`), [Any](`typing.Any`)\] | iteration numbers), returns (-1, None) — a legitimate             |
|        | [tuple](`tuple`)\[[int](`int`), [Any](`typing.Any`)\] | "fresh install, no model yet" state.                              |

## Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

| Name   | Type                 | Description                                                                                                  |
|--------|----------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | [OSError](`OSError`) | If the latest model file exists on disk but cannot be deserialised (corrupt joblib, version mismatch, etc.). |
